summary_1line: Sugriva, fearing Bali’s plot, sends Hanuman in disguise to investigate the identities and intentions of the armed strangers Rama and Lakshmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva and a band of monkeys leap frantically from crag to crag on the mountain, shaking rocks and scattering frightened animals below.
Hanuman stands respectfully before the anxious Sugriva on the mountaintop as the monkey chiefs gather around their king.
Hanuman sets out alone from the mountain to approach the two armed princes, Rama and Lakshmana, standing calmly in the forest below.
